name: 04_announcement
topic: Trackin now covers 50 cities across Pakistan — major expansion milestone
headline: Now Covering 50 Cities
supporting_text: We just expanded to 30 new cities across Pakistan

brief.objective: Announce Trackin's expansion to 50 cities in Pakistan, establishing leadership in transit technology and driving brand awareness.
brief.audience: Urban commuters, fleet operators, and public transport authorities in Pakistan seeking reliable, tech-driven transit solutions.
brief.marketing_angle: Highlight the milestone as a testament to Trackin's commitment to seamless mobility and nationwide connectivity.
brief.key_message: Trackin now connects 50 cities across Pakistan, making intelligent transit accessible to millions.
brief.tone: Professional and confident, with a forward-looking, tech-optimistic vibe.
brief.visual_direction: A dynamic map of Pakistan illuminated with 50 glowing nodes, linked by sleek data streams, overlaid with a subtle tech grid.

bible.typography: Inter: headings Bold 40px, subheadings SemiBold 26px, body Regular 18px

bible.lighting: Glowing neon backlight from data nodes, soft rim light on map relief, ambient blue-orange gradient light, high contrast between bright accents and dark background
bible.texture: Smooth vector lines, subtle digital grid with faint noise, soft glow halos around nodes, slight metallic sheen on data streams
